scope: All twenty source color/clay/wireframe models, complete twenty-theme Unity overview, nine required confusion groups, native 64/128 car-width hidden-name sheets. Individual family views and geometric checks supplement this review.

confusionComparisons.observation: Rolled pinched cowboy brim; checked double-visored deerstalker; folded tricorn; tall bent cone. Body motifs are star, lens, skull and magic.
Short swept horns and cheek guards versus open crown peaks; round wood shield versus crown motif.
Small wings, antennae and rounded striped pod versus hardhat. Honeycomb/bee print versus straight hazard/tool print.
Two broad printed wings versus thick leaf fronds versus wrapped candy. Wing spots and veins differ from leaf veins and swirls.
Two exposed gears, boxy visor head and cylindrical smokebox/chimney are different outlines. Copper, cyan and green/brass bodies reinforce them.
Cloud and supported bolt versus crystal cluster versus tilted planet ring. Yellow bolt and rain differ from ice and orbital graphics.
Opened clapper bar and film reel print versus a stepped camera with large lens barrel; body artwork is film reel versus aperture.
Short striped capsule and scissors versus horizontally wrapped sweet and swirl. Navy/ivory/red differs from pastel mint/pink.
Conical flask with narrow neck versus broad saucer with eye stalks; laboratory flask print versus alien face.

limitations: Native 64 px reduces small printed detail; palette and silhouette carry most of the visible distinctions at this size.
Supplier hood UV islands split motifs into smaller patches on several bodies.
This is an authoring inspection, not measured player performance or evidence of one-second recognition.

The current Level camera and sampled sideways display rotation render the raw unscaled car at a small, awkward angle; the neutral views and native car-width thumbnails provide the clearer readability evidence. No camera or scene was changed.
followup: All required source, fitting, nonregression and catalog checks passed. No unresolved planned product.
